title: Finite-Shift Inverse-Concavity and Exterior Noncollapsing for Fully Nonlinear Curvature Flows of Nonconvex Hypersurfaces
summary: We give a finite negative-shift criterion for preserving a prescribed exterior noncollapsing bound under fully nonlinear curvature flows whose hypersurfaces need not be convex. The criterion uses the optimized two-point expression of Andrews and Langford. We verify it by a uniform global two-matrix estimate for the explicit speed \[ F_{\varepsilon}(A)= tr A- \varepsilon\frac{\norm{A^{\circ}}^{2}}{ tr A} \] on the open cone \[ Γ=\{A\in\Sym(n): tr A>0, \norm{A^{\circ}}< tr A\}.\] Here $A^\circ$ denotes the trace-free part of $A$.
